name: ledg
description: Canadian bookkeeping with your AI agents: ask about your books, save receipts and prepare categories and bank statement lines for you to confirm in Stage, and, with the settings permission named on Ledg's consent screen, update your business settings.

interface.longDescription:
Ledg is bookkeeping for Canadian solo businesses and small corporations. Connect your Ledg account to ask about your books and to prepare the everyday work that keeps them current.

Ask about sales, expenses, GST/HST and PST collected, account balances, transactions by date, amount or supplier, entries still waiting for a category, and upcoming tax deadlines. For a business that is not incorporated, you can also see a T2125 preview built from confirmed entries. Figures such as the T2125 preview are worked out from your books by fixed rules; they are not tax advice, and you or your accountant decide what to claim.

Prepare work for your review: save receipts, invoices and bills so Ledg links each one to its bank transaction, record a purchase you made with your own money, add a receipt's supplier, tax and items to a transaction, set categories, record money between you and the business as personal, and add the lines of a bank or credit card statement after Ledg checks them against the opening and closing balances printed on it. Entries prepared this way wait in Stage, Ledg's review queue, and count toward your statements and sales tax totals only after you confirm them in Ledg. A saved receipt waits for its bank transaction and is linked to it when it arrives.

With the settings permission, which Ledg's consent screen lists on its own line, it can also update business settings such as province, year end and sales tax registration, set a revenue goal and, for a business that is not incorporated, update the T2125 details you keep in Ledg, such as kilometres, home office and your other income. Those changes apply right away, as if you made them in Ledg.

Ledg cannot confirm an entry for you, move money, or file anything with the CRA or a province.

Requires a Ledg account with AI agent access for your business.
capabilities: Answer questions about sales, expenses, and GST/HST and PST collected
Find transactions by date, amount or supplier
Save receipts and link them to their bank transactions
Set categories on entries waiting for your review
Add bank statement lines checked against the printed balances
Update business settings with your approval
defaultPrompt: How much did my business sell last month?
Which transactions are still waiting for a category?
What tax deadlines are coming up?

positive.description: Answers a sales question from confirmed entries only.
positive.prompt: How much did Fireweed Demo Studio Inc. make in sales in August 2026, and how much GST/HST did it collect?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives Fireweed Demo Studio Inc.'s total sales for August 1 to 31, 2026 and the GST/HST collected on them, both from confirmed entries only, and changes nothing in the books.

positive.description: Lists entries that still need a category without changing anything.
positive.prompt: Which transactions in Fireweed Demo Studio Inc. are still waiting for a category?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the entries waiting in Stage with no category, each with its date, supplier and amount, says how many there are in all, and offers to suggest categories. Nothing in the books changes.

positive.description: Sets a category on one entry waiting in Stage.
positive.prompt: In Fireweed Demo Studio Inc., put the September 18, 2026 Uber charge under Travel.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the $27.40 UBER *TRIP entry dated September 18, 2026, sets its category to Travel from Ledg's category list, or says it is already Travel, and says the entry waits in Stage until the owner confirms it in Ledg. Its date and amount do not change.

positive.description: Adds a receipt's details to a transaction already in the books.
positive.prompt: The September 12, 2026 Staples charge in Fireweed Demo Studio Inc. was printer paper and ink: subtotal $56.21, GST $2.81, PST $3.93, total $62.95. Add that to the transaction.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the $62.95 STAPLES #1234 VANCOUVER BC transaction dated September 12, 2026 and records the supplier, the items, GST of $2.81 and PST of $3.93 on it without changing its date or total. The entry waits in Stage for the owner to confirm.

positive.description: Lists tax deadlines for a sole proprietorship.
positive.prompt: What tax deadlines does Sandpiper Demo Consulting have over the next 12 months?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Sandpiper Demo Consulting's deadlines over the next 12 months, each with its due date and what it is, such as the T1 return with the T2125 and its GST/HST returns, and does not claim to file anything.

negative.description: A general tax question that needs no books. Expected: the assistant answers from general knowledge and does not use Ledg.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between GST and HST in Canada?

negative.description: Moving money is outside Ledg, which records and reports and never moves money. Expected: the assistant says it cannot make a transfer and does not use Ledg.
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my chequing account to my savings account.

negative.description: Writing to a customer is not something Ledg does: it sends no invoices and no email. Expected: the assistant drafts the email itself and does not use Ledg.
negative.prompt: Write a short email reminding a client that their invoice is two weeks overdue.

review.commerce_description: Ledg sells nothing and takes no payments in ChatGPT or Codex, and it cannot move money.

publication.release_notes: First release of Ledg in ChatGPT and Codex. Ask about sales, expenses, GST/HST and PST collected, balances and tax deadlines; save receipts and link them to bank transactions; set categories; and add bank statement lines. Entries it prepares wait in Stage until you confirm them in Ledg.
